name: @lumphammer/equilux
description: Sunrise, sunset and twilight anywhere in the world, charted over the year
author: Neil de Carteret

scripts.data:local: node scripts/build-places.ts && wrangler d1 migrations apply equilux --local && wrangler d1 execute equilux --local --file=data/places.sql
scripts.data:remote: node scripts/build-places.ts && wrangler d1 migrations apply equilux --remote && wrangler d1 execute equilux --remote --file=data/places.sql
